title: Intersections of quantitative recurrence and badly approximable sets for expanding Markov maps
summary: We study a class of expanding Markov maps on the unit interval, which includes sofic \(β\)-transformations, Gauss maps, tent maps and cookie-cutter maps. We investigate the quantitative recurrence property for points that are dynamically badly approximable, namely, points whose orbits eventually remain a positive distance from a given point. We show that the Hausdorff dimension of the intersection of a recurrence set and a badly approximable set is determined by the same pressure function as that of the corresponding recurrence set.
